name: SIM PairBy
description: Test fixture for answer-keyed pairing: a collect-choice split, a pairwise collect with pairBy mode opposite, then a pair-scoped reveal. Underscore-prefixed so it never appears in game lists. Driven by scripts/simulate-pairby.js.

pick.prompt: Would you rather have a cat or a dog?

why.prompt: You and your partner may have chosen differently. Tell them why you picked yours.
